mapping.summary: Plans preventive maintenance on plant equipment and tracks downtime, work orders and costs.
claims: An AI agent picks up maintenance requests from incoming email and processes them
Tracks planned and unplanned downtime events in real time
Compares planned and actual labour and material cost
Monitors team utilisation, parts used and external vendor spend
Uses maintenance history to support replace-or-repair decisions
Preventive orders triggered by time, output quantity, runtime hours or custom triggers
Parts and vendor services go through standard purchase documents and requisition worksheets
Planned maintenance stops are taken into account in production planning
Maintenance team resource calendar with even distribution of work requests
Maintenance history per equipment or asset group
Links to BC Projects for larger maintenance and capital improvement jobs
Technicians view and update work orders on handheld devices via EOS PowerApps
Keeps audit-ready records for lease or regulatory maintenance reviews
